text:
Toledo among 55 Oregon cities tied for 51st in July scam reports
By
C. L. BarkerToledo reported one scam in July 2026, placing it among 55 cities tied for 51st out of 105 Oregon cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report, according to Better Business Bureau.
There were no scam reports listed for the city in the previous month.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to cause large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
